title: qos.t1 re-bless cause-doc is false: pinned 65s T2 golden proves the trigger element did NOT change to bundle 0
evidence: spec change-log (f906725): "qos.dem's trigger element changed (bundle 0 vs the blessed bundle 1) — T1/log/T2 re-blessed," / app/render/crisis.odin:61: "title = fmt.aprintf(\"!!  %s: %s ACTIVE — bundle %d (pipe %d)\", ... ac.bundle, ac.pipe" and crisis.odin:97: "if ac.kind == .Saturated_Bundle && ac.bundle == b {" / git diff b94d54f f906725 --stat -- goldens/: " goldens/qos.t1 | 602 ++--" only (no qos.log.bin, no goldens/qos/65000ms.png) / harness/goldens.odin:39: "rc.ready = true" (unconditional) and goldens.odin:123: "append(fails, fmt.aprintf(\"T2 %dms: %d/%d pixels differ (bbox %v) — diff bundle at %s\"..." / CI on f906725: all 4 verify jobs SUCCESS (harness gate = T1 + T2 + replay, ci.yml: "Golden harness (T1 hashes + T2 software pixels + replay gate): tools/harness.sh run"). Blessed goldens/qos/65000ms.png (unchanged in the commit) renders the banner "bundle 1 (pipe 1)" with the outline on that bundle's pipes (image inspection).
detail: The rework's own cause-doc claims the qos trigger element moved bundle 1→0 and T2 was re-blessed; only qos.t1 changed. With the zero-tolerance T2 gate CI-green, the 65s banner still shows bundle 1 — the claim is false and the real cause of the 1200–1503 hash shift is undocumented.
recommended_fix: Correct the change-log and PR body: qos's element stayed bundle 1; the 1200+ shift came from the trigger-tick change (pass reorder / class-lane predicate). Document that tick shift; drop the false "element changed" and "T2 re-blessed" claims.
